acceptance_question: Does Current Ethics-Law turn accepted concepts, identities and exact boundaries into a coherent concept-boundary → normative-judgment → situational-application path without becoming a definition/list course?

master_chain: why moral and legal literacy must be learned together
life view: person-society coordinate and value evaluation
ideal-belief: long-term direction connected to reality and practice
Chinese spirit / patriotism: individual aspiration connected to national community
core values: common value scale separated by national/social/citizen levels
morality: origin/nature -> socialist core/principle -> scenario-based practice
law: legal nature/operation -> rule-of-law governance -> constitution -> personal legal thinking and rights/obligations
whole_subject.strongest_attack: Ethics-Law can easily degrade into definition cards, twelve-word/eleven-item memorization queues and moral/legal slogan matching. Fresh C00-C06 readback instead found a consistent judgment-first design: identify the semantic/normative layer, contrast the nearest confusable concept, then apply it to a concrete relation or scenario. Dense fixed structures stay backend/source-primary unless their identity itself is high-value.
negative_space: Chengfeng remains the only continuous first-round mainline on iPad/MarginNote.
Full morality/legal lists and examples remain source-primary unless real question evidence activates precision.
Unreadable or unsupported exact wording is not filled from model memory.
A chapter review_prompt is a compression cue, not a mandatory ritual.
P2/provisional content does not automatically become active recall or Memory debt.
Xiao1000 validates boundary/application transfer and does not organize first-learning order.

criteria.concept_identity_first: The learner first knows what kind of object/norm is being judged.
criteria.nearest_boundary: Each high-risk concept is separated from its closest confusable neighbor before exact wording is emphasized.
criteria.situational_application: Abstract norms are connected to concrete actor/relationship/action judgments rather than left as definitions.
criteria.cross_chapter_continuity: The subject progresses from individual life/value judgment to shared norms and finally legal governance/personal legal practice.
criteria.source_negative_space: Dense examples and unsupported exact lists remain Chengfeng/source-primary.
criteria.minimality: No extra recall workflow is created solely for architectural symmetry.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: common regulation goal -> different moral/legal mechanisms -> mutual support without substitution
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could collapse into two parallel definitions.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the chapter centers the boundary between value/internal-self-regulation and institutional/force-backed regulation, then applies it to scenario classification.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: person-society relation -> purpose/attitude/value chain -> social-historical evaluation anchor -> dialectical life contradictions
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could become abstract life-philosophy slogans or deny legitimate individual development.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the personal-social coordinate and objective social-historical value scale govern later judgments, while contribution and legitimate self-development remain non-exclusive.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: ideal as realizable future direction -> belief as stable action support -> ideal-belief interdependence -> ideal-reality unity -> personal/common ideal coordination
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Ideal/belief features and classifications could become isolated lists.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because classification detail is deferred; first learning is relational and practice-based.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: Chinese spirit layers -> national-spirit/patriotism vs era-spirit/reform-innovation -> contemporary patriotism boundary -> innovation in practice
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Four Great spirits plus several core identities could become hat matching.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the chapter first fixes level and object: rich connotation, national-spirit core, era-spirit core, and their joint relation to Chinese spirit.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: why common value scale -> country/society/citizen three-level structure -> advanced/people/real characteristics -> behavior practice
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Twelve words could dominate the chapter as a recitation wall or be confused with the broader core-value system.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because each four-word group answers a distinct level question and the core-values vs core-value-system boundary is explicit before precision.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: moral origin/nature/function layer -> socialist morality identity -> service-people core vs collectivism principle -> inherited resources -> public/professional/family/personal scenarios -> practice
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Core/principle, morality functions and four scenario norms could become a dense mixed list; unsupported exact function names tempt model completion.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because role identities are separated, scenarios organize application, and missing exact function wording is explicitly deferred rather than guessed.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: law nature/operation -> Xi rule-of-law thought/road/system/goal/work pattern -> constitutional root -> legal thinking + rights/obligations
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Highest hat density: thought/road/system/goal/four links/three-in-one construction/constitution/legal-thinking contents can collapse into one memorization queue.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because each fixed identity answers a different governance-level question and the final unit forces situational discrimination among legality, power constraint, fairness, rights and procedure.

conclusion.note: Learning Logic only. Projection must still prove the generic Politics page preserves boundary-first cognition and does not expose backend lists as a second course. R/E/U remain unaccepted.
